title: Illusion of Freedom (Naked)
description: This is the naked variant, with just my pure voice without the distraction of sound effects, layers or binaural beats. You are Shibby’s Chastity Slave. Poor thing, you've been caged and in my service for half a year now! So tonight, I bring you to my dungeon for a checkup, one which I promise will end with a reward. Before you know it you’re bound, blindfolded, and helpless on my bed. It seems like I'm going to edge you and make you cum. But with Domina… things are rarely so straightforward. What exactly do I have planned for you? And why do I insist on taking away your senses before giving you your reward? When you’re pledged to serve Shibby, earning the chance at getting some freedom may not be what you expect.
author: Mistress Shibby
